title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Yeah, yeah, I get it, you deserve a nice rest in your off time. But you gotta get your treatment right now.

title: Talk 1
original: Huh? You want me to be gentle and caring? That's nurse stuff, pal. I'm a doctor, from top to toe. That means healing. Treatment. Don't waste my time with the fluff.

title: Talk 2
original: Strange, why does Dr. Kal'tsit keeps telling me to 'be nice to patients'? She's been doing it ever since I got here.

title: Talk 3
original: Your average doctor's biggest concern is keeping herself safe. Mine, on the other hand... it's getting my patients to stop being scared of me.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Treatment time, ears open! Eyes on me! Hands up! Don't move!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Doctors and fighters... life-savers, life-takers. People think we're polar opposites, but I think we're one and the same—we both sacrifice.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Huh? I didn't beat anyone up, I just wanted to say hi. Watch, lemme demo... I initiate physical contact, and that's how I get closer to people, see?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I'm kinda missing my homeland... I chose to be a medic myself, but it's crazy it all turned out the way it did. Life sure took me down some wild paths, huh?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor... you and I are both travelers on a lonely road. I guess that's why we understand each other so well.

title: Idle
original: What the... you're asleep, huh? Heheh.

title: Onboard
original: I'm Medic Operator Gavial. First things first... Don’t judge me by the way I look. Got it?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Tch, I thought we were gonna have combat class.

title: Promotion 1
original: Everyone's so scared of me treating them... You're the only one who accepts me for what I am. Thanks for that.

title: Promotion 2
original: All right, no more fooling around. I'll be serious from now on.

title: Added to Squad
original: Leave the rear to me. Go show what you're made of!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: All right, get in line, everyone!

title: Depart
original: All right, ladies. Let's keep it cool.

title: Begin Operation
original: Coming!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Let's begin.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Where do you need me?

title: Deployment 1
original: Ready to heal!

title: Deployment 2
original: Who needs healing? Come over!

title: In Battle 1
original: If you want treatment, you gotta come closer!

title: In Battle 2
original: Don't get yourself killed, dummy!

title: In Battle 3
original: Come on, get it together!

title: In Battle 4
original: Hang in there, I'm coming!

title: 4-star Result
original: Meh, pushovers. I wasn't even breaking a sweat.

title: 3-star Result
original: Man those guys were weak. I regret not giving 'em a few whacks with the staff here.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Have you guys never taken emergency response training courses?

title: Operation Failure
original: Darn it... I'm not giving up yet!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Let's see if there are any interesting people here!

title: Tap
original: Hey, knock it off!

title: Trust Tap
original: You want me to just nod and listen? No. Freaking. Way.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Finally, New Year's! The croc doc is in and she says today's a rest day! Speaking of, they really celebrate New Year's peacefully out here. I kinda miss the Acahualla-style ceremony. Kal'tsit probably wouldn't approve holding it here at Rhodes Island though...

title: Greeting
original: Hey, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday to you, Doctor. Speaking of, I oughta give you a little present... Let's take this opportunity to give you a full, thorough physical exam!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: You want my thoughts on what being a Rhodes Island doctor's been like? Nothing too special. Whether punching enemies into submission or using my staff to make patients listen, there's always a sense of accomplishment. It was my choice and I made it, so there's nothing to waffle over.
